metadata.description: Qwen multimodal understanding plugins — Agent Skills + MCP servers

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-core
plugins.description: Inspect local files and media, extract video frames, and crop or annotate images.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-nifti
plugins.description: Inspect NIfTI volumes with configurable slices, shared intensity ranges, and window presets.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-api
plugins.description: Understand images, audio, and video through model APIs, including OCR, object localization, and speech transcription.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-search
plugins.description: Search the web, read pages, and identify objects or places with reverse-image search.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-video-memory
plugins.description: Build searchable, hierarchical memory of long videos to summarize content and locate events, text, and dialogue.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-omni-memory
plugins.description: Build and query audio-visual memory to track speakers, dialogue, sounds, and events across videos.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-video-edit
plugins.description: Edit existing footage into finished videos with pacing, sound, subtitles, and visual effects.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-edu-agent
plugins.description: Create narrated Mandarin math and science tutorial videos or interactive explainers from problem statements and images.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-blender
plugins.description: Create, refine, and render 3D scenes and assets in Blender.

plugins.name: qwen-mm-plugins-freecad
plugins.description: Create and edit parametric CAD models, technical drawings, and model exports in FreeCAD.
